description: Rank TV stations or shows mentioning a query. Station values are percentages of each station’s monitored airtime, or raw matching 15-second clip counts with normalize=false. Show values always represent percentages of matching clips, even with normalize=false. Labels are preserved exactly; ellipsized show labels may not work as exact show: selectors. Returns 25 rows by default, up to 10,000 per page. Archive coverage varies by station; use gdelt_list_tv_stations for station IDs, network and market selectors, and monitoring date ranges.

breakdownBy.description: Rank stations by their airtime share or matching clip count, or shows by percentage of matching clips.

endDatetime.description: UTC end in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format. Must pair with an earlier startDatetime.

limit.description: Maximum ranking rows per page (default 25, cap 10,000). Larger counts clamp with limitClamp; strict deployments reject them.

normalize.description: Station rankings: true returns station-airtime percentages; false returns matching 15-second clip counts. Show rankings always return matching-clip percentages.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset after descending-value and exact-label sorting. Use nextOffset with the same query inputs for the next page.

query.description: TV transcript query. Supports phrases, Boolean OR, station:CNN, network:CBS, market:"National", show:"Bloomberg Best", and context:"vaccine".

startDatetime.description: UTC start in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format. Must pair with a later endDatetime.

stations.description: Station IDs to select; every supplied ID is forwarded. Alternatively select station:, network:, or quoted market: in query. A selector is required; obtain values from gdelt_list_tv_stations.

timespan.description: Relative time window, such as 1m or 6m. Ignored when both explicit datetimes are supplied. Check per-station archive coverage before selecting a window.

name: gdelt_get_tv_breakdown

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: Only one explicit datetime was supplied, a datetime is not a real UTC timestamp, or startDatetime is not earlier than endDatetime. `offset_out_of_range`: The requested row offset is at or beyond the end of a non-empty ranking. `invalid_query`: GDELT rejected the query or the TV timespan is malformed. `gdelt_rate_limited`: GDELT rejected its request-spacing limit, or the request queue could not start this call in time. `gdelt_unavailable`: GDELT TV API is unreachable or temporarily returned no usable data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Applied maximum rows on this page.

limitClamp.description: Present only when the requested count exceeded the per-call cap: the call ran exactly as a call at the cap, and every count, notice, and continuation in this response reflects the applied value.

applied.description: The per-call cap the call ran with instead.

parameter.description: The count input that was clamped.

requested.description: The value the call asked for.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; absent when no rows remain.

notice.description: Empty-result guidance, show percentage and selector limitations, or station catalog resolution limitations.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of this ranking page.

rows.description: Rows sorted by descending value, breaking ties by exact label, from the requested page.

items.description: A station or show ranking row.

label.description: Exact provider station or show label, including any ellipsis.

station.description: Catalog station ID for a resolved station row; absent for shows or unresolved labels.

value.description: Ranking value in valueUnit; no rescaling is applied.

staleResponse.description: Present only when the refetch of this exact request was refused, failed, or came back empty, and the response is GDELT's stored answer from fetchedAt instead. It holds nothing published after fetchedAt; a relative timespan covers the window ending at fetchedAt, not now. Absent on a live answer.

ageSeconds.description: Age of the stored answer when served, in whole seconds.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 time GDELT returned the stored answer.

reason.description: Why the refetch was not used: GDELT rate-limited it, did not answer with data, or answered empty — which GDELT also does under load.

totalRows.description: Full ranking row count before pagination.

truncated.description: True when additional rows remain after this page.

valueUnit.description: Station-airtime percentage, matching-clip percentage for shows, or raw matching 15-second clip count for stations.

title: Get GDELT TV Breakdown
